placements.why: This envelope's content — a directive fixing a recurring rehearsal cadence, its documented restatement, and a named owner — is organizational-operational in kind: it establishes how the org keeps a system capability real over time and who is accountable for it. Nothing in the (empty) existing strata covers this, and the content is foundational enough to found the category rather than extend something close-but-not-exact.
placements.title: recurring operational disciplines and the accountability that anchors them
placements.frame: What recurring operational practice is being mandated here, and who is made accountable for keeping it real?

placements.title: rehearsal is constitutive of the capability, not a supplement to it
placements.frame: Is this treating a recovery capability as real only insofar as it has been rehearsed on a mandated cadence, and by what authority and ownership is that cadence fixed?
placements.why: src-1 issues the monthly rehearsal cadence as a directive sealed by an aphorism that equates an unrehearsed rollback with no rollback at all — this names a subject (rehearsal as the test of real capability) that future envelopes about drills, cadences, and readiness verification would keep feeding, not a one-time fact. src-2 restates the same cadence as a settled parameter, and src-3 assigns the owner accountable for it — both are the documentary scaffolding of the same mandate rather than facts needing their own leaf, so they support this leaf rather than minting separately. No existing narrative leaf exists in this fresh graph to reuse, so this founds the theme under the newly-minted Organization strata.
